title: Morgan Fox Named CLO
summary: FBIN’s Board of Directors has appointed Morgan Fox EVP & CLO, effective December 2, 2026.
body_markdown:
Fortune Brands Innovations announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Morgan Fox to serve as Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer & Corporate Secretary, effective December 2, 2026.


“Morgan brings deep experience advising boards and leadership teams on complex transactions, governance matters and business decisions, and will be an important partner as we strengthen execution and position Fortune Brands for long-term success. We are pleased to welcome her to the team,” said Singh.


For more information, view Fortune Brands’[November 3rd announcement.](https://ir.fbin.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fortune-brands-innovations-names-morgan-fox-executive-vice)
